p: Burton's fourth-down false start was a young-player mistake that LaFleur does not expect to recur.
The young lineman is playing in an offensive line under scrutiny, and the unit's instability hurts all GB skill players.
I don't anticipate it happening again.
Burton will play meaningful snaps along the offensive line.
He is competing with Banks at left guard and will likely see more action given the O-line injuries.
I would expect him to end up having to play some football for us.
